integrity: Proof is analytic; independently executable deterministic finite diagnostics corroborate but do not establish its universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Proved for noncircular planar ellipses and integer n >= 3; quantitative coefficient not sharp; no full perimeter extremizer classification; historic priority is subject to older billiard literature.
title: Strict finite-vertex area–perimeter incompatibility for noncircular ellipses
